note: Recast from Roonwal & Chhotani 1997; the original is in English and does not describe the alate (Imago: Unknown). For the head width of the large soldier the OCR reads "1.6()^1.68", corrected from the context to 1.60—1.68 mm. The original gives a complete description and measurements of the worker, of which only the essentials are summarised here.

sections.label: Soldier
sections.text: Large soldier: body length 5.60—6.60 mm; head length to the mandibular bases 1.68—1.85 mm, head width 1.60—1.68 mm; antenna 16 segments; labrum width 0.50—0.53 mm, length 0.33—0.40 mm; mandible length 0.96—1.02 mm; postmentum median length 1.12—1.18 mm, maximum width 0.43—0.50 mm, waist width 0.30—0.33 mm; pronotum length 0.60—0.63 mm, maximum width 1.00—1.09 mm; tibial spur formula 3:2:2. Small soldier: body length 3.65—4.09 mm; head length 0.90—1.07 mm, head width 0.76—0.90 mm; antenna 15 segments; labrum 0.36—0.45×0.20—0.25 mm; mandible 0.53—0.63 mm; postmentum 0.53—0.60×0.30—0.36 mm, waist 0.23—0.26 mm; pronotum width 0.56—0.63 mm, length 0.40—0.45 mm.

sections.label: Worker
sections.text: Body pale yellow; head subquadrate; antenna 15 segments; the remaining characters and measurements are given in the original worker description.
